fields.statement: At commit 45055620: a build of ./cmd/rhiza prints '- import  topic  502 tokens  Import: bringing an existing repo...' in `rhiza guide ls`, and `rhiza guide import` prints headings 1. Init, 2. Survey, 3. Record built capabilities, 4. Bring in load-bearing decisions, 5. Retire planning documents into Sources, 6. Write unbuilt work as draft change sets, 7. Verify, in that order. `go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/^guide$` passes; guide.txtar checks the import topic in guide ls and the seven steps in order with a (?s) regexp. `go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/...` passes, including TestCaps (size cap) and TestListOrder with import. Read the diff: commands and link types the text names (apply --record, decided-by, derived-from, change new, check, render, why) exist.
